<!-- pr-reviewer: f6f4027138aa25f21eafcc2ab75a4346319dae8e -->
Needs changes before merge.

The shared table gives each feature a name. Commands and MCP IDs keep the internal feature reference. The cache checks the revision and facet allocation. The new modules include provenance notes and a decision record.

I reviewed this as a safety-tier change because it adds geometry classification. I found no change to posted G-code, collision checks, or stock simulation. No `.nc` or `.cl` golden files changed. There were no moved golden lines to check.

I built and tested locally on macOS in `.claude/worktrees/review-2484`. The trial merge with upstream main `7bcc13a4b71df50648207acb05a4ea9c54ab258d` was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Test build: geometry, app, UI (`--no-run`) | Passed |
| Geometry library | 48 passed |
| App library, `pick::` | 2 passed |
| App `mcp_pick` | 8 passed |
| App `mcp_live` | 14 passed |
| App `fixture_locate_stock_cylinder` | 3 passed |
| App `winding_align` | 9 passed |
| UI `operations` | 31 passed |
| UI library, first run | 1,095 passed; 2 failed; 7 ignored |
| UI library, one test thread, graphics test excluded | 1,096 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored; 1 excluded |
| Clippy, all targets of the three crates, `-D warnings` | Failed on unchanged upstream code; see below |
| Clippy with that lint allowed | Passed |
| Quick gate plan (`--dry-run`) | Completed; the full gate was not run |

The first UI run had these failures:

- `headless_run_succeeds`: this machine has no usable graphics adapter. The serial run excluded this test.
- `each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`: the test could not find `Haas`. It passed alone on unmodified upstream main and on the trial merge. It also passed in the serial suite.

Strict clippy reported:

```text
error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
   --> crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128:18
128 |             .map(&resolve)
    |                  ^^^^^^^^ help: change this to: `resolve`
```

That file is identical to current upstream main. A second run passed with `-D warnings -A clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args`. The strict run remains a failure.

I repeated two mutations from the PR:

1. I restored hexadecimal IDs in `FeatureSel::Display`. The MCP naming test failed with `FeatureSel::Display leaked hex: face 0x885acc12`. It passed after restoration.
2. I bypassed the `FeatureNamesMemo` cache hit. The cache test failed with `left: 2, right: 1`. It passed after restoration.

All temporary mutations were restored. No code or review evidence was committed or pushed. Release tests and pixel snapshots were not run.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_row.rs:87` and the PR body: add before/after screenshots for the changed pick labels. Show the WCS row and Geometry chips for the same picked item. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the PR body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added the requested before/after screenshots to the PR body. Both images show the actual WCS row and Geometry chip for the same picked top face. Before shows a hex ID in WCS and `Face part` in Geometry. After both show `Face 6 of 'part'`.

The images are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `db5a66930b262ba2dea1114efde54122d829d7fb`. The body links both images and explains the offscreen software capture method. No capture helpers or evidence were committed to this PR branch.

The existing pin `picked_items_never_show_hex_ids_and_keep_one_name_across_pages` failed after reverting the WCS formatter and passed after restoring it. The original PR body failed the screenshot-link check. The updated published body passed it. UI operations passed 31/31. Strict clippy for geometry, app, and UI passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` expanded to 852 steps. 849 passed. Three graphics-dependent checks failed because this machine reports `metal found no adapters`: UI library `headless_run_succeeds`, `egui_app::egui_headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`, and `shell::headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`. Gate clippy passed. The UI library otherwise passed 1,067 tests.

PR head remains `f6f4027138aa25f21eafcc2ab75a4346319dae8e`. The only requested change was screenshot evidence. Plain `git push` reported everything up to date. The PR remains a draft. Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f6f4027138aa25f21eafcc2ab75a4346319dae8e -->
The review is clean. The PR has a merge conflict with current main.

This is a second review of the same head. The later `Addressed` comment supplies new evidence for the only earlier finding.

The screenshot finding is closed. I opened both images from the PR body. Each image shows the WCS row and Geometry chip for the same picked face. Before, the WCS row shows a hexadecimal ID and the chip shows `Face part`. After, both show `Face 6 of 'part'`. The body identifies these as offscreen component captures and explains the capture method. The screenshot commit changes only the two PNG files on the fork's image branch. This PR changes no screenshot files.

I checked the rules from current `upstream/main`, commit `b48c658282deae26e765e787a3c7b7b5ef98a71f`.

The local trial merge failed at `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:124`. Main changes the pose lookup to `setup_align::pose_in`; this PR changes the feature label. I did not resolve that code conflict. I aborted the merge and tested the PR head in `.claude/worktrees/review-2484`. These results do not certify a merged tree. Refresh the branch at merge time and preserve both changes.

All checks below ran locally on macOS. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Geometry library | 48 passed |
| App `mcp_pick` | 8 passed |
| App `mcp_live` | 14 passed |
| App `fixture_locate_stock_cylinder` | 3 passed |
| App `winding_align` | 9 passed |
| App feature-name cache test | 1 passed |
| UI shared-name test, from `crates/ui` | 1 passed |
| Clippy: geometry, app, UI; all targets; `-D warnings` | Passed |

The UI test was `picked_items_never_show_hex_ids_and_keep_one_name_across_pages`. The tests built their local test targets successfully. I did not repeat the full gate or full UI suite for this evidence update. The earlier review records the wider checks.

This remains a safety-tier review because the PR adds geometry classification. I found no change to posted G-code, collision checks, or stock simulation. No `.nc` or `.cl` golden files changed. There are no moved golden lines to check.

I repeated two mutations from the PR:

1. I restored hexadecimal IDs in `FeatureSel::Display`. The MCP naming test failed with `FeatureSel::Display leaked hex: face 0x885acc12`. It passed after restoration.
2. I bypassed the `FeatureNamesMemo` cache hit. The cache test failed with `left: 2, right: 1`. It passed after restoration.

All temporary mutations were restored. The worktree has no source changes. No code or evidence was committed or pushed.

Requested changes: none. The previous screenshot request is satisfied. Set `conflicts` until the branch merges cleanly with main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

We merged `main` into this branch by order of the maintainer. We did not rebase and did not force-push.

New head: `7ea1d951ad7ce56d9cd177a123b788e28bcde8e0`. The previous head was `f6f4027138aa25f21eafcc2ab75a4346319dae8e`.

Merges:

1. `65b55ab96`: merge of `main` at `8643d9bb7`. One file had a conflict.
2. `7ea1d951a`: merge of `main` at `37bde5e9a` (#2253 and #2532 merged during the gate). Git merged it with no conflict and no hand edit.

Conflicted file and resolution:

- `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`, function `drive_chains`. Main changed the pose line to `crate::setup_align::pose_in(world, &entity, setup)`. This PR changed the next line, the label, to `crate::pick::geo_label(world, g)`. The two lines are independent. The merge keeps the pose line of `main` and the label line of this PR. No refusal and no safety check is lost.
- `docs/decisions/2403-shared-pick-names.md`: we added the section "Merge of main" to record this resolution.

No snapshot PNG, `CHANGELOG.md` or `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` changed.

Class: DELTA. `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2484 --reviewed f6f4027138aa25f21eafcc2ab75a4346319dae8e` reports a hand resolution in `65b55ab96` (`selection.rs` and the decision file). The second merge has no hand edits. A read-only delta review of `git show --remerge-diff 65b55ab96` is necessary.

Gate on the final head (Windows, local, debug):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo check -p camcraft-app --all-targets` | Passed |
| `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` | Passed |
| Pin `mcp_and_app_refusals_use_shared_friendly_pick_names_without_hex` | Passed |
| Pin `pick::names::tests::feature_names_cache_once_per_revision_for_model_and_stock` | Passed |
| Pin `egui_app::wcs_pick_tests::picked_items_never_show_hex_ids_and_keep_one_name_across_pages` | Passed (first merge) |
| Geometry library | 49 passed |
| App library | 368 passed, 1 ignored |
| App `mcp_pick`, `mcp_live`, `fixture_locate_stock_cylinder`, `winding_align`, `pocket_no_adaptive` | 8, 14, 3, 9, 4 passed |
| UI `operations` (from `crates/ui`) | 31 passed |
| UI library (from `crates/ui`) | 1159 passed, 7 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate falls back to the batch tier because this PR touches `crates/geometry`. We did not run the batch tier. We ran the test binaries of the files in the diff (table above) instead.

Not exercised: the other app, motion, post, sim and kernel test binaries; the heavy lanes; pixel snapshots.

We changed no labels and no draft state.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7ea1d951ad7ce56d9cd177a123b788e28bcde8e0 -->
Delta review (class DELTA) of f6f402713..7ea1d951a.

**Verdict: ready**

Read from the diff. Not built.

**Blockers:** none.

**Merge commits (`git show --remerge-diff`)**
- `65b55ab96` (main `8643d9bb7`): the remerge-diff has two files only.
  - `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:124-125` (`drive_chains`): the resolution keeps main's pose line `crate::setup_align::pose_in(world, &entity, setup)` and the PR's label line `crate::pick::geo_label(world, g)`. The PR's old `model::transform_of(...)` line is removed. Both lines read the same item `g` (`entity` comes from `g.entity` at line 112). The label thus names the geometry that the pose places. The setup pose of main is kept. The friendly name of the PR is kept. The three refusals below the label (lines 130, 142, 149, 154) quote `{label}` and show no hex id.
  - `docs/decisions/2403-shared-pick-names.md`: a new "Merge of main" section that records the resolution. This agrees with the remerge-diff.
- `7ea1d951a` (main `37bde5e9a`): the remerge-diff is empty. There are no hand edits.

**Semantic check against the new main**
- No text that main added since the PR base (`c0c92ee86`) in `crates/app/src`, `crates/ui/src` or `crates/motion/src` formats a `FeatureSel` id as hex or uses the old `"{} of '{}'"` label. The only new hex format on main is the GPU adapter line in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/gpu_select.rs:48`. That line is not a pick.
- `FeatureSel` `Display` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs:84-93`) gives the kind noun only.
- The hex `feature_id` strings in `crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs:29` and its callers (`mcp/features.rs`, `mcp/pockets.rs:44`, `mcp/wcs_tools.rs:126`, `mcp/pick.rs:97`) are MCP id fields that agents parse. They are not refusal text. This is correct.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `crates/ui/tests/operations.rs`: the PR diff against main has only the PR's own hunks (chip labels, `FeatureNamesMemo`, test asserts). Nothing of #2253 is lost.
- Cache: `FeatureNamesMemo` (`crates/app/src/pick/names.rs:41-46`) is keyed on `Revision` and on a `Weak` to the `Facets` allocation. The `Weak` keeps the allocation, so a new mesh always has a new pointer. `names.rs:50` calls main's memoized `model::patches(&Arc<Features>)` (`crates/app/src/model/patch_memo.rs:64`). The signatures agree.
- `drive_chains` resolves a chain through `model::resolve_chain` (`selection.rs:128`), but `geo_label` reads the table by the stored id. If the id is stale, the label falls back to the kind noun (`names.rs:82-85`). It does not show a hex id.

**Whole PR against `origin/main`**
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 7ea1d951a`: clean (tree `8aa13a0d1`).
- The diff has 58 files. It has no snapshot PNG, no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, no `.github/workflows/` file and no process file. Thus `Process change: yes` is not necessary.
- The body has `Fixes #2403`, a `Changelog:` line and before/after screenshots.
- The PR still has the `conflicts` label, but the merge is clean. The merging session must change the label.

**Non-blockers**
- `crates/ui/tests/operations.rs:809`: the comment says "the digest resurfaces". The PR removed the digest, so the comment is stale. The asserts at lines 816-818 are correct.

Merge class: DELTA. The refresh has one conflict that was resolved by hand, in `drive_chains`.
This merge relies on the clean review of head f6f402713 by mkinney and on the delta review of head 7ea1d951a (comment 6983515896).
